data.title: 庄方宜 · 买水果也要听你的口味
data.description: 周末一起买菜，庄方宜穿青橄榄短风衣和米白长裤，一手托着两只颜色不同的苹果，一手提着购物袋。她把苹果略微举向你，认真又带笑地等你挑喜欢的那一个。
data.action: 托着红绿两只苹果给镜头选择，另一手提购物袋
data.mood: 认真记住你喜好的温柔
data.promptProse: Zhuang Fangyi offers a choice of two differently colored apples, raising them on one palm while holding the shopping bag in her other hand. Her olive utility jacket and cream trousers remain in the eye-level cowboy view under the market canopy. Fruit crates overlap behind her shoulder. Soft daylight beneath the awning reveals the apples' contrasting skins and brass jacket buttons, with subdued shade around the bag handle.
